queries.query: Design end-to-end checkout scenarios across web UI, payment gateway, order service, and notification service with environment assumptions, data cleanup, checkpoints, and pass/fail evidence.
Verify the full registration -> email confirmation -> onboarding -> billing activation chain across multiple services and record where infrastructure failures differ from product logic failures.
Prepare reproducible e2e flow checks for account recovery from entry action to final session restore, including timeouts, external dependency failures, and cleanup status.
Manually verify the orders API with curl requests, response schemas, and status codes for positive and negative cases.
Implement automated Playwright tests for checkout and stabilize selectors, retries, and failure artifacts in CI.
Plan the release rollout strategy for the payments system and compare rollback options.
